summary:
P5 grind pass (gact-tui#333 E3/E4/E6/E8, HandoffPart rework): tool_call+tool_result now merge into ONE collapsible row (closed by default, ✓/✗ mark + duration in the header, full untruncated text in the well on open) instead of two permanently-open cards with mismatched wrench/gear icons — live-verified against a real failed geo call and a real 300+-char JSON result, both shown in full once opened. expert_handoff now always shows the Call()+question (sourced from the real metadata.question field) plus a status card, and StatusDot's running colour is corrected to the prototype's accent orange (never the success green) with a real error state wired from the live delegate.failed/status fields — live-verified on the real LA-ground-motion session where a running vs. a completed-successfully vs. (unit-tested) a failed child card now render three genuinely different ways. resource_link now renders as the prototype's 28px icon-tile artifact grid, grouped per run, instead of a bare cyan link — live-verified with a real PNG artifact. Narration bullets are the mono '●' the prototype uses, not a redesigned bar; the thinking body has its guide rail back; the waiting-for-background marker pulses; the async-injection pill is compact, not boxy. Remaining gaps are genuinely unbacked, not rendering defects: the focused-agent-transcript pane the child card would open into does not exist yet (E9, tracked separately) — the card no longer LIES about being clickable (cursor:pointer removed) while that's true; the artifact chip's meta line is real (mime_type/description) because the wire carries no size/row-count for resource_link (E7, tracked separately); HITL cards, the a2ui live widget, and the streaming cursor remain honestly absent because the backend does not yet emit the data they'd need.

PASS 2 (re-verification, no rendering regressions found): every non-'match' item was re-measured against the CURRENT tree (which moved since pass 1 — a dead CollapsiblePart.tsx was deleted, a data-message-id attr was added — neither touched conformance) and, for the two Call-card items, against the prototype's OWN turnSegs/isTask builder read directly out of design/prototype/Clio Session.html rather than assumed from its CSS/template alone: across every trace fixture the prototype ships (5 `hs`/isTask segments total), `sg.handle` is never populated, so the prototype's own 'run-handle' pulsing-dot pill is real, fully-wired grammar the prototype's own author never actually renders on screen either — pixel-confirmed by cropping a live prototype capture (screenshots/side-by-side/crop-call-card.png: 'geospatial ↗', zero dot) alongside a fresh live-backend probe of the app's own running/completed child cards (crop-card1-head.png / crop-card2-head.png: dot only while running, absent on success, colour-correct). This re-scopes the expert_handoff Call-card deviation with hard evidence instead of inference, without changing its status or attempting the half-migration E9 (child-card click + the handle-pill split) is meant to land as one slice. Two stale citations were corrected (the HITL ask/permission items pointed at a registry.tsx comment that no longer exists post-refactor; both now cite the current transcript.test.tsx documentation). One new regression lock was added (tests/unit/transcript-async.test.tsx: the completed child card carries no role/tabindex, pinning the 'no lying affordance' fix). No src/ rendering code changed this pass — pass 1's implementation held up under live re-probe against the real LA-ground-motion and compute-task sessions (fresh screenshots/side-by-side captures), including a newly-observed real failed tool call (relay_wait, ✗ mark, red duration) that was not available to verify against in pass 1.

PASS 2 re-measurement of the prototype's own turnSegs builder (design/prototype/Clio Session.html, the isTask branch): across BOTH bundled trace fixtures (the default LA-ground-motion trace's 4 `hs` segments and astTraceDefs' 1 `hs` segment — 5 total, 0 exceptions), `sg.handle` is NEVER populated, so the prototype's own optional 'run-handle' pill (the ONLY place its isTask grammar ever puts a pulsing dot) is real, designed, fully-wired grammar that the prototype's own author never actually exercises on screen either — confirmed by direct pixel inspection (screenshots/side-by-side/crop-call-card.png crops the prototype's live-rendered 'geospatial ↗' card: bold name + cyan arrow + zero dot, matching the builder's fields exactly, no err/mark path exists for isTask at all, unlike the tool segment's explicit mark/markCol). Live-verified the app's CURRENT behaviour against the real backend the same way (screenshots/side-by-side/crop-card1-head.png running vs crop-card2-head.png completed): the accent dot shows ONLY while running and is genuinely absent on success, which is non-misleading and color-correct, but its PLACEMENT (inside the card border, unconditional on 'running') is still the app's own simplification of the separate always-optional pill the prototype defines. There is also still no arrow/↗ affordance (deliberately omitted — see the child-card-click item; adding it without a working destination would repeat that lie). Reproducing the prototype's exact isTask structure (separate handle pill sourced from a real async-handle wire field the observed expert_handoff sample does not carry, the arrow, unclamped-vs-3-line-clamp body) remains the E9 Call-agent-grammar work — now re-scoped with hard measurement instead of assumption, still correctly out of this part-renderer pass (tracked task: 'E9 implementation — new Call-agent grammar', paired with the child-card-click item so both land as one coherent slice rather than a half-migration).
